heroEyebrow: Clinical Herbalist · Naturopath · Former elite athlete
heroCredentials: Dip. Herbal Medicine · Dip. Naturopathy · Indian Head Massage Certificate · TCM Dispensary Training
heroBody:
You have probably already explained your symptoms to someone who wasn't really listening. You may have left appointments feeling smaller than when you arrived. You may have started to wonder if you are the problem.

You are not the problem.

I am Sara. I am a clinical herbalist and naturopath. I have also been that patient — the one who was told to push through, to stress less, to be more realistic. I know what it costs to keep searching when the system keeps sending you home empty-handed.

This practice exists because I found another way for myself, for my family and friends. And I want to help you find yours.
practiceTitle: Plant medicine rooted in lived experience
practiceBody1:
Plant medicine found me when I had run out of other options. Seven years of specialists, hormonal suppressants, surgeries, and eventually a build up of increased doses of strong painkillers just to numb the pain — and still I was barely able to function on most days. When I finally started working with plants, it was my last cry for help. My journey to a better health was slow and full of mistakes. But for the first time in years, something was actually working.

That experience lives in every consultation I offer. I know what it is to search for answers your body already has but you can't understand. I know what it means when someone finally takes the time to hear you and let you make decisions for yourself.
practiceBody2: I started on myself. Then quickly after, my family became my first clients. I watched people I loved get better. That was when I knew I needed to train properly.
practiceQuote: Coming back into a body that has felt like a battlefield is not heroic resilience. It is small, daily work. It asks for patience, and for the willingness to give yourself grace in the process.
offerIntro:
Every person who comes to me has already tried something. They have seen doctors, changed their diet, pushed through, rested more, worried quietly. They have not been lazy or dramatic or impatient. They have simply been working with tools that were not built for the complexity of what they are carrying.

What I offer is a different kind of attention, to the whole of you, not just the presenting symptom.

offerCards.title: Herbal Medicine
offerCards.desc: Plant medicine formulated for your body, not your diagnosis. Drawing on Western phytotherapy, Traditional Chinese Medicine, and Ayurvedic study — whichever tradition serves your situation best, sometimes all three.

offerCards.title: Naturopathy
offerCards.desc: The part of my practice that asks why. Nutrition, lifestyle, sleep, stress — the patterns that have become so habitual they feel like personality. Always integrated with herbal medicine, never a checklist.

offerCards.title: Constitutional Assessment
offerCards.desc: Iridology, tongue and pulse reading — used during every initial consultation to understand your constitution before formulating your protocol. The depth that makes personalised medicine genuinely personal.

offerCards.title: Hormonal Health and Chronic Fatigue
offerCards.desc: This is where my practice began. Seven years of my own illness taught me that hormonal conditions are not one thing. Your version of endometriosis, PMOS or chronic fatigue is specific to you. And your protocol should be too.

offerCards.title: Athlete, Injury and Performance Support
offerCards.desc: From a practitioner who trained at national level and knows what it costs when a performance body stops cooperating. Recovery, trauma, inflammation, metabolic issues — clinical and personal in equal measure.

offerCards.title: Indian Head Massage
offerCards.desc: Bodywork rooted in the Ayurvedic tradition. For the tension that lives in the neck, shoulders and scalp. For the nervous system that needs something more. Clients leave feeling like they are floating. In person only.

whoTitle: Who I work with, and why
whoDesc:
My practice is built around the people I understand most deeply, because I have been them.

Women navigating hormonal conditions that conventional medicine keeps minimising. Athletes whose bodies have stopped performing the way they used to. People who have been running on empty for so long they have forgotten what it felt like to have reserves.

If you recognise yourself in any of that, you are in the right place.

whoCards.title: Women with hormonal conditions
whoCards.desc: Endometriosis, PMOS, chronic fatigue, perimenopause, fertility, menstrual irregularity. I have lived these conditions. I have also spent two years treating them in clinic.

whoCards.title: Athletes & active people
whoCards.desc: I trained at national level. I understand performance, recovery, overtraining, and the very specific grief of a body that won't cooperate. I have practice with musculoskeletal trauma and can accompany you in your recovery.

whoCards.title: People exhausted by burnout
whoCards.desc: Stress, nervous system dysregulation, adrenal fatigue, insomnia, the quiet erosion of a life run on empty. Herbal medicine and naturopathy have deep tools for this while Indian head massage offers an immediate relaxation.

storyPullBody: An athletic career cut short. Years of being dismissed by specialists. A pandemic that became, unexpectedly, the beginning of something new. A family who became my first patients. And a slow, imperfect, deeply personal discovery that plant medicine could do what nothing else had managed.
storyPullQuote: I was not living. I was surviving. Until I stopped waiting for someone else to give me permission to heal.
processTitle: From first conversation to lasting change

processSteps.title: Discovery call
processSteps.desc: Free, 15 minutes. Tell me where you are and what you have already tried. I will be honest about whether I think I can help, and what that would look like.

processSteps.title: Initial consultation
processSteps.desc: 90 minutes. We go deep into your history, your patterns, your daily life — the things that feel unrelated but probably are not. This is a conversation, not an intake form.

processSteps.title: Your protocol
processSteps.desc: A personalised herbal formulation, naturopathic guidance, lifestyle adjustments. Built for your specific body and situation, written up and sent within 48 hours.

processSteps.title: Ongoing support
processSteps.desc: This is where the real work happens. Your part is showing up — taking the blends, following the protocol, making the changes. My part is adjusting as your body responds. Healing takes time, and I stay with you through it.

processSteps.title: Follow-up consultation
processSteps.desc: 35–40 minutes, 4 to 6 weeks after the first consultation. We review your progress, reassess the protocol and take your healing journey to the next step.

testimonials.text: I left the Indian head massage feeling like I was floating. I genuinely forgot where I had parked my car. Something in my neck that has been tight for two years just... wasn't anymore.
testimonials.author: Student clinic client

internationalTitle: Your language. Your timezone. Your care.
internationalDesc1: Most of my consultations happen online, which means geography is rarely a barrier. Clients in France and the UK work with a practitioner who understands the Western tradition from the inside. Clients elsewhere access clinical-level herbal medicine without having to compromise on quality or connection.
internationalDesc2: I practise in English and French. I understand the particular comfort of discussing your health in your mother tongue, the precision it allows, the ease it creates. That matters in a consultation, and I take it seriously.

regions.name: France & Francophone Europe
regions.desc: Online and in person when I am in the country.

ctaTitle: If any of this resonates with you — let's talk.
ctaDesc: A free 15-minute discovery call. No pressure. Just tell me where you are, and we will figure out together whether I am the right person to support and guide you.
